seven_kill_guards.6_data_continuity_VOID_rule: treat ANY feed/expiry change as VOIDING the log, not degrading it. A change in the OPRA data vendor/feed, the expiry cycle, the strike-ladder convention, the panel schema, or weeklies/0DTE entering the volume-OI proxy VOIDS the accrued forward log (it is discarded and a NEW frozen forward test begins) -- a data discontinuity is NEVER silently absorbed as a bad forward result. seven_kill_guards.7_monthly_coverage_check: each month, verify the OPRA panel actually covered that month's monthly (3rd-Friday) expiries for the single-name universe (front AND next monthly). A month with missing or partial coverage is VOID for that month, not a zero -- a phantom mark is never fabricated.
